desc: Identify the reduction from pairings to assigning selected cakes to \(X\), \(Y\), or \(Z\) groups with even group cardinalities.
Correct the one-special candidate logic so the assigned coordinate is forced by the remaining parity.
Correctly re-derive all two-special positional categories, including the both-inside parity key and boundary index \(q\), without cake overlap or incorrect ordinary-cardinality sums.
Validate the implementation against the provided sample tests.
Prove the corrected algorithm’s optimality, including duplicate triples, ties, and \(K=1\) edge cases.
Establish worst-case \(O(N\log N)\) time and \(O(N)\) memory under total \(N\le 10^5\).
Produce the final Python implementation with fast input and 64-bit-safe arithmetic.
